item: Row 66 part 3: source-quality cohorts use the deduced language when none was stated, marked as deduced
summary: Field report 2026-11-14: articles with no stated language fell out of every language cohort. The cohort language is the stated Article.language, else the indexing-time detected_language, with a language_deduced flag in the sample record. Article.language is never overwritten (Q3); read-side only, no re-extraction. Baselines and language_mismatch_rate shift for sources that state no language.
